phase: Phase S3: Structured output for the evaluation features
summary: Security applicability is applicable; the test strategy marks S3 risk critical and the 55e7952b..ed397155 diff adds a PII strip move, two provider prompts, and a new untrusted-JSON parse path. The audited HEAD ed397155 is current and provenance-bound. My heavy-runs at HEAD pass every S3 security group: the Fix 1 no-PII test passes (the PM release gate proof is green, so the gate can open), the package S3 fix group passes 6 (findings b, c, and e N1, N3, N5), the IM3 S3 fix group passes 7 (six strip forms and the rate-limit catch), the structured output group passes 9, and the three BM2 no-PII tests pass. The gates.sh key() edit hides no real failure: I replicated the per-key compare over the recorded s2 and s3 gate logs and got new_keys=0 for all four workspaces, and the old filter shows the edit drops only the two stdout framing headers of passing teacher tests. One blocking finding stands: the new structured helper writes the unvalidated model string from the response body into the usage record (structured.ts:215 and structured.ts:245), which breaks the S3.7 rule that a usage record holds the served model only under the finding (b) validation that providers.ts applies (providers.ts:312 and providers.ts:336); a response that echoes a bare key form would print it to the console log, the exact ADV-S3-8 condition. Three nonblocking findings follow: short known-details values can corrupt lesson math, the BM2 rate-limit catch logs a fixed status null, and the teacher route outer catch still logs the raw error object.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] packages/ai-tutoring: the structured-output helper logs the served-model field of the response body with no validation. packages/ai-tutoring/src/structured.ts:215 stores result.model into servedModel when it is a string, and structured.ts:245 passes servedModel into logAiRequest, which usage-log.ts:25 prints to the console. Rationale: test-strategy.md S3.7 states that a usage record holds the served model only under the finding (b) rule and that no log line holds a key. The chat path applies the finding (b) rule at both the read (providers.ts:312, safeModel with the sk- rejection in MODEL_ID at providers.ts:212) and the log (providers.ts:336), and roles.test.ts:266-287 proves a bare key form gives model null there. The structured path bypasses the rule, so a response body that echoes a bare key form (the exact ADV-S3-8 condition) reaches the log unvalidated and unbounded. Fix in Green: apply the same bounded-model rule in structured.ts by reusing one validator (no second implementation) and add a failing-first test in structured.test.ts that mirrors roles.test.ts finding b.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] packages/ai-tutoring: stripPersonDetails removes each known account value everywhere with no minimum length. lesson-context.ts:89-92 splits and joins on each value, the BM2 route passes session.username (route.ts:183), and apps/bus-math-v2/convex/auth.ts:117 accepts username: v.string() with no length floor. Rationale: a one- or two-character username deletes every occurrence from the lesson math text in the prompt. The accepted over-breadth limit in evidence.md covers capitalized labels only, not this form. No leak occurs. Fix: skip values below a bounded length or match on word boundaries, with one test.

F3 [Nit] apps/bus-math-v2: the rate-limit catch of the student lesson-chatbot logs a fixed status null. route.ts:101-105 binds no error and prints JSON.stringify({ role: 'studentTutor', status: null }). Rationale: the plan says log the status and the role, and IM3 extracts the real status with getErrorStatus (IM3 route.ts:172-177). No leak occurs, but the log cannot name the failure status. Fix: bind the error and extract the status as IM3 does.

F4 [Nit] apps/bus-math-v2: the teacher ai-error-summary route still logs the raw error object in its outer catch. route.ts:137 prints the error unchanged. Rationale: the line predates S3 and the plan scoped finding (d) to the two chatbot routes, but S3 edited this route and the phase rule says the raw error object reaches no console call. The structured helper never throws, so the error holds Convex and mapping text only. Fix it when the route is next touched.

gates.sh key() edit hides no real failure: I replicated the key() pipeline over gates/s2/test-*.log against gates/s3/test-*.log and got new_keys=0 for ai-tutoring, practice-core, integrated-math-3, and bus-math-v2. With the old filter the only extra keys are the two 'stdout |' framing headers of passing teacher tests (case 13 and case 15). FAIL, AssertionError, and TS lines remain; I count 13 of those keys in gates/s3/test-bus-math-v2.log, which matches the sanity claim in evidence.md.

Teacher route authorization holds: requireActiveTeacherRequestClaims gates the route (route.ts:30), zod validates the query (route.ts:38-48), the rate limit runs (route.ts:52-61), and the student must share the teacher organizationId (route.ts:75-81) or the route answers 404.

Teacher summary sends no student PII: buildTeacherSummaryPrompt holds no student name (ai-error-summary.ts:31-99) and the 'Refer to the learner only as the student' line is at ai-error-summary.ts:38. The no-PII test places fixture values in the teacher profile, the student profile, the submission detail, and the student ID, then asserts the captured prompt holds none of them while the response keeps studentName (ai-error-summary.no-pii.test.ts:169-181). It passed in my run.

Structured output validates untrusted model JSON: JSON.parse then z.strictObject safeParse (structured.ts:258-266), typed failure reasons, no throw. My 'structured output' run passed 9/9, including the response_format body assertion (structured.test.ts:79-101) and the provider boundary assertion (structured.test.ts:103-118).

A2 not applicable: the S3 diff flips no draft-to-published status. The only publish reference is a read of buildPublishedCurriculumManifest (BM2 route.ts:166) and its test mock. No named subject is published.

A6 verified: measure/tracks.md:245 describes the spec scope only, and no tracks.md text claims a security state is resolved. Each S3 plan task that claims a fix cites a red proof and a green log, and my runs confirm each fix test passes at HEAD.

The camelCase responseFormat is still remapped on the wire, so structured output stays enforced; Red case 3 asserts the boundary object and no assertion covers the serialized provider field. The accepted strip over-breadth limit is also recorded in evidence.md.
